personality.description: This person is imaginative and novelty-seeking, often jumping into new ideas, unusual perspectives, and spontaneous plans with enthusiasm. They tend to keep an irregular routine, rely on bursts of energy rather than steady organization, and may leave tasks unfinished or deadlines to the last minute. In moral dilemmas, they usually stay calm and unshaken, but they approach choices strategically and competitively, questioning others’ intentions and favoring outcomes that protect their own interests. In group discussions, they speak openly and energetically, enjoy leading the flow of conversation, and readily challenge opinions they find weak while remaining composed and hard to rattle.
